spanish: Y los santificarás, y serán santo de santos; todo el tocante en ellos se santificará.

findings.issue: Qal imperfect 3ms is stative (be/become holy). “se santificará” adds a reflexive or passive sanctifying action and changes stem force.

notes: Piel 2ms “santificarás”, 3cp “serán”, and construct קדש קדשים as “santo de santos” stay within the tokens.
